benefits.title: Why order with Tarkaari
benefits.ecoBody: Your vendor brings vegetables in reusable crates and bags. No delivery packaging to throw away.
benefits.freshBody: Picked at the morning market for your order, not stored for days in a warehouse.
benefits.localBody: You pay your building's vendor directly. No big company in between, no commission taken.
benefits.wasteBody: Your vendor buys only what was ordered, so less goes unsold and thrown away.

intro.label: How Tarkaari works
intro.freshTitle: Order by 5 pm, fresh next morning
intro.freshBody: Your building's own vendor buys at the morning market for your order and brings it to your door.
intro.localBody: Pay your vendor directly by UPI or cash. No big company in between, no commission taken.
intro.ecoBody: No plastic packaging: vegetables come in reusable crates and bags. Vendors buy only what's ordered, so less food is wasted.
